description: Microsoft Monetize server-side conversion pixels on sspx-router.adnxs.com/sspx and secure.adnxs.com/sspx. Microsoft documents id as the pixel ID and sspdata as the landing-page token. Browser /px stays vendor/xandr.

params.name: id
params.description: It is the Monetize conversion pixel ID. Microsoft documents id on every SSPX call.
params.fix_hint: Set id to the conversion pixel ID from Monetize.

params.name: sspdata
params.description: It is the SSP token from the landing page. Microsoft documents sspdata as the populated ${SSP_DATA} value.
params.fix_hint: Set sspdata to the token the landing page received after the click.

params.name: order_id
params.description: It is an order ID or SKU. Microsoft documents the same order_id field as on the browser pixel.
params.fix_hint: Set order_id before sspdata when you pass an order or SKU.

params.name: value
params.description: It is the dynamic revenue. Microsoft documents a purely numerical value on conversion pixels.
params.fix_hint: Set value to a number with no currency symbol, such as 10 or 10.50.
